title: Child Care Access Key to Improving Parent Mental Health, According to New Research
summary: New report from KinderCare highlights positive impact consistent, high-quality child care can have on helping parents avoid burnout Key takeaways: KinderCare research shows child care access is a critical driver of parent well-being and workforce stability. Parents report spending more than one-third of each month burned out, with child care challenges as a leading cause. KinderCare identifies child care gaps as a primary source of stress for modern families. 81% of parents say they are constantly thinking about disruptions in care, reinforcing the need for consistent, reliable solutions. KinderCare data underscores the importance of high-quality child care on parents’ mental health. 60% of parents say parenting pressures are harming their mental health, highlighting child care as essential infrastructure for families.
